stem: According to Paragraph 1, the careers of scientists can be determined by ______ .
choices: how many citations their works contain
how many times their papers are cited
the prestige of the people they work with
the status they have in scientific circles

stem: The support service consultancies tend to ______ .
choices: recommend journals to their clients
list citation patterns for their clients
ask authors to include extra citations
advise contributors to cite each other

stem: The function of the ``milk cow'' journals is to ______ .
choices: boost citation counts for certain authors
help scholars publish articles at low cost
instruct first-time contributors in citation
increase the readership of new journals

stem: What can be learned about Scopus from the last two paragraphs?
choices: It fosters competition among citation providers
It has the capability to identify suspicious citations
It hinders the growth of ``international'' journals
It is established to prevent citation manipulation

stem: What should an author do to deal with citation manipulators?
choices: Take legal action
Demand an apology
Seek professional advice
Reveal their misconduct
